en.title: Magnetic Micro-Robots Deliver Chemotherapy Directly to Tumors in First Human Trial
en.summary: ETH Zurich spin-off Microsenso reports successful Phase I trial results for magnetically-guided micro-robots that navigate blood vessels to deliver chemotherapy precisely at tumor sites, reducing systemic side effects by 80%.

zh.title: 磁性微型机器人首次人体试验：将化疗药物直接输送至肿瘤
zh.summary: 苏黎世联邦理工学院衍生公司 Microsenso 报告，磁导微型机器人成功完成 I 期临床试验，可在血管中导航，将化疗药物精确递送至肿瘤部位，将全身副作用降低 80%。
